schema.description: Mapping from original 12 genre types (L2) to merged 6 buckets (L1) for News-Domain texts.

L1_definitions.hard_factual_reporting: Straight factual reporting centered on concrete events (who did what, when/where), typically with clear actors and attributable actions.
L1_definitions.deep_factual_narrative: Narrative-driven but still fact-grounded reporting (investigations, profiles/biographies), often longer-form with richer context and implied values.
L1_definitions.attribution_heavy_discourse: Texts organized around explicit attributions (Q&A, interviews, quoted statements), where actor stances are expressed via direct speech.
L1_definitions.explainer_analysis: Explainers and analyses that synthesize facts with interpretation, background, or causal reasoning (including many science/tech explainers).
L1_definitions.soft_lifestyle_consumer: Soft/consumer-oriented content (lifestyle, culture, reviews) where actions and actors may be weaker or more implicit; values may be personal/experiential.
L1_definitions.non_fact_based_stress_test: Out-of-scope or stress-test content with stronger rhetoric, persuasion, or humor/satire; also includes miscellaneous/noisy items.
